title: Relational exit-token transport event three-seed capacity training
purpose: Test whether explicit cross-frame exit-token transport improves safe causal junction/terminal commit over the old pooled-token model.

approval.scope: One immutable C01-C06 fit/C07-C08 selection three-seed capacity run; zero C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution after readiness PASS.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 three-seed raw exit-token cache.
Sealed final unified learned geometry observation features.
Sealed transport feasibility and readiness V1R evidence.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Every observation is visited exactly once per epoch through episode-preserving batches; no row deletion, resampling across splits or future frame.

teacher.source: Corrected causal junction/terminal episode target and episode ID.
teacher.student_input: Only frozen raw exit tokens and learned geometry context; target/episode are used by MIL only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Model proposes commit/provisional nodes only; no edge or graph is created in this run.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies all gradients and the already frozen token normalization.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07-C08 selects minimum episode MIL checkpoint among six epochs and one decision threshold from the fixed 0.000:0.001:1.000 grid.
split.strict_test: C09/C10/M-TARE unread until this capacity passes.
split.historical_pollution_audit: No failed structured-polar output or strict-test evidence enters the model.

methods.main: Train three random initializations of the 240101-parameter relational token-transport event model for six complete episode-preserving epochs with AdamW, batch 128 and episode MIL.
methods.baseline: Sealed old per-frame mean/max pooled ActionSetNodeDetector: macro-F1 0.743847, trigger precision 0.965870 and episode recall 0.498239.
methods.fallback: If ensemble safety/gain or seed stability fails, seal scientific FAIL and stop this event route before graph.

acceptance.population: Exactly 142184 fit and 45942 selection observations, 3282/1136 decision episodes and three random seeds.
acceptance.optimization: Three seeds x six epochs x 1111 batches = 19998 optimizer steps; 240101 parameters per seed; frozen perception outputs receive zero updates.
acceptance.ensemble: Trigger precision>=0.995, false fraction<=0.005, episode recall>=0.25, junction/terminal precision>=0.99 and recall>=0.25, all ten families represented.
acceptance.gain: Decision episode macro-F1 >=0.793847, at least five points above the exact pooled baseline.
acceptance.stability: At the ensemble threshold every individual seed has trigger precision>=0.98 and episode recall>=0.25.
acceptance.system: Zero C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner, exact source replay, complete checkpoints/outputs/figures/logs/seal.

failure_policy: Any data, environment, optimizer-count, threshold, safety, gain, seed-stability or isolation failure stops and seals FAIL; no changed epochs, losses, grid or graph compensation.
retention: Retain three checkpoints, histories, selection outputs, ensemble threshold/metrics, paper figure/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three deterministic CUDA trainings and one CPU selection evaluation
